posts.text: Kite App for Watch — Disclosure first: I built the app I’m about to mention, so read this as a builder’s note. For the “MTM positions on the wrist” part of this request: OnWrist is an Apple Watch app that shows your Kite positions’ P&L on the watch. It is read-only and uses your own Kite Connect API app, so the API secret stays on your iPhone and watch. What it does not do, so nobody is misled: no exit button and no order alerts (it cannot place or change an order at all), and it is for Apple Watch only.
